CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition is linked to the identified content's organization or access in the text.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an explicit origin/status entry, and a layout/organization statement are all present and bind to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color labels with coordinate sets) are present.

D.rationale: The report separately lists content identity (red coordinates) and a distinct origin/status field for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The text describes how content is presented/organized (grid orientation, explicit origin/provenance and candidate inheritance).
